title: Card - Case Study
description: Case-study card shell for the Work archive: banner zone, content body, and tag row. Adapts between light and dark mode like every other card style — border uses a translucent tint of the shared card border token. Non-expressible structural properties (overflow) and the hover state stay in src/scss/structural/work-project-card.scss — a bare &:hover in this css field is silently dropped, same class of bug as @media/@supports stripping. The card also renders real post-terms links (platform badge, tag pills) alongside the stretched read-more link — those get their own stacking layer so they stay clickable above the full-card overlay instead of being swallowed by it.
